objective: Continue the full Oyatie mockup toward Bominal-grade completeness by upgrading the sparse daily tasks, approvals, schedule, and personal operator queue into one dense cohesive execution workbench.

bominal_patterns_reviewed: /tmp/bominal-ref/docs/design-system/README.md Stripe x Palantir flat dense tactical visual language

gap_analysis.source: current runtime inspection after command center, evidence, resource, service catalog, business logic, and communications polish slices
findings_addressed: The lower dashboard still had a sparse Daily work plus Today's schedule area, which regressed against Bominal's dense operator-console reference language.
Tasks, approvals, schedule, evidence, Mail, Messenger, and Workflow routes were visible elsewhere but were not integrated into one personal execution queue.
The surface did not expose filtering, search, route actions, calendar pressure, capacity pressure, or evidence handoff as first-class local interactions.
The mockup needed more cohesive product behavior without wiring real backend execution.

implemented: Replaced the old sparse daily task and schedule panels with one full-width Daily Work · Personal Operations console.
Added a typed ExecutionRow model and generated a unified queue from tenant tasks, approvals, schedule holds, and synthetic evidence rows linked to REC-WF-7741 and REC-PAY-2026-04-PARK.
Added dense KPI cells for tasks, approvals, calendar holds, blocking items, and evidence links.
Added searchable and filterable daily rows with All, Blocking, Tasks, Approvals, Schedule, and Evidence filters.
Added row-level local actions for Flow, Mail, Evidence, and Stage, each updating visible state and routing into existing cohesive surfaces.
Added sidepeek metadata hooks for daily work rows so selection exposes owner, risk, SLA, and description in the existing shell side panel.
Added a calendar/capacity rail with timeline holds, capacity bars, and a route matrix to Workflow, Mail, Messenger, and Audit Evidence.
Updated static SSR mirror so the full daily execution console is visible before hydration and remains useful with fallback JavaScript.
Updated fallback interactions so search/filter/action behavior is visually functional while preserving the no-backend/no-send prototype constraint.
Encoded Bominal-style flat tactical styling in CSS: low radii, dense borders, muted tactical colors, spreadsheet-like KPI rows, and compact operator controls.

observations: live server reachable on 127.0.0.1:3000 after 4 seconds

verification.command: Playwright smoke for #daily-execution, KPI density, row count, filters, search, Mail route, Evidence route, Stage action, console/network health
pixelmatch secondary debug diffs against Bominal corporate, workflow-studio, and employees references cropped to shared viewport

observations.method: pixelmatch threshold=0.12, anti-alias ignored; secondary structural evidence only

visual_verdict.category_match: Bominal-style daily operator execution console integrated with Workflow, Mail, Messenger, Evidence Spine, and calendar pressure
visual_verdict.verdict: The daily work area no longer reads as a sparse task widget. It now behaves like a cohesive operator workbench with dense queue rows, schedule pressure, capacity state, route actions, local status updates, and audit handoffs while staying aligned with the flat tactical Bominal visual language.
improved_matches: The section now uses spreadsheet-like KPI bands, dense rows, and tight low-radius controls instead of generic card lists.
Tasks, approvals, schedule, and evidence are unified into one product concept with a shared search/filter/action model.
Mail, Messenger, Workflow, and Evidence routes are visually functional and integrated with the existing product shell rather than separate demo widgets.
SSR and fallback interactions both preserve the complete daily console before any backend is wired.
remaining_differences: No real workflow execution, email send, messenger post, calendar write, approval mutation, or evidence write is wired.
This advances the complete mockup; the full product still needs a final cross-surface completion audit against the Bominal reference set.

non_claims: No production task, approval, schedule, mail, messenger, workflow, or evidence operation leaves the browser.
All interactions are local prototype state for visual and UX validation.
This is one additional polish slice toward the full mockup, not a claim that the entire dashboard is complete.
